files.description: Exam scores (60 rows, one per student): student (full name, unique, many with accented letters), then math, art and music (scores 35-100, whole numbers; about 9% of these score cells are empty, and one student has no score at all).

task_text: For each student who has at least one score, count in how many of the three subjects they have a score. `result` should be a Series indexed by student.
intended_computation: Count the non-empty score cells per student and keep the 59 students with at least one score (the student with no score at all is left out); counts are 1 to 3 and sum to 164.

predicted_direction.reason: Counting the rows of stack() per student was right on 2.x, where empty cells were dropped; on 3.x every student gets 3, including the student without any score.
